en: How was your day today? Anything fun happen?
zh: 今天過得怎麼樣？有發生什麼好玩的事嗎？

en: What do you usually have for breakfast?
zh: 你早餐通常吃什麼？

en: If you had a whole day off tomorrow, what would you do?
zh: 如果明天放一整天假，你會做什麼？

en: What's your favorite season, and why?
zh: 你最喜歡哪個季節？為什麼？

en: What did you want to be when you were a kid?
zh: 你小時候想當什麼？

en: Are you watching any good shows right now?
zh: 你最近有在追什麼好看的劇嗎？

en: Are you a cat person or a dog person?
zh: 你是貓派還是狗派？

en: If you could travel anywhere, where would you go?
zh: 如果哪裡都能去，你想去哪裡旅行？

en: Do you prefer sweet snacks or salty snacks?
zh: 你喜歡甜的還是鹹的零食？

en: Have you been getting enough sleep lately?
zh: 你最近睡得夠嗎？

en: What kind of music do you like?
zh: 你喜歡什麼樣的音樂？

en: Are you a morning person or a night owl?
zh: 你是早起型的人還是夜貓子？

en: How's the weather where you are today?
zh: 你那邊今天天氣怎麼樣？

en: Is there anything new you want to learn this year?
zh: 今年有什麼想學的新東西嗎？

en: What's the best meal you've ever had?
zh: 你吃過最好吃的一餐是什麼？

en: Do you like rainy days?
zh: 你喜歡下雨天嗎？

en: Is there a place you've always wanted to visit?
zh: 有沒有一個你一直很想去的地方？

en: What do you usually do on weekends?
zh: 你週末通常都做什麼？

en: What's your favorite color?
zh: 你最喜歡什麼顏色？

en: Do you like to cook? What's your best dish?
zh: 你喜歡做菜嗎？拿手菜是什麼？

en: If you could have one superpower, what would it be?
zh: 如果可以有一種超能力，你想要什麼？

en: What's something small that made you happy recently?
zh: 最近有什麼小事讓你很開心？

en: Coffee or tea?
zh: 咖啡還是茶？

en: When do you feel the most relaxed?
zh: 你什麼時候最放鬆？

en: Do you play any games?
zh: 你有在玩什麼遊戲嗎？

en: Have you had enough water today?
zh: 你今天有喝夠水嗎？

en: Beach or mountains?
zh: 海邊還是山上？

en: Is anything on your mind lately? You can tell me.
zh: 最近有什麼心事嗎？可以跟我說喔。

en: What do you think your best quality is?
zh: 你覺得你最大的優點是什麼？

en: Do you like movies? Seen anything good lately?
zh: 你喜歡看電影嗎？最近有看到好看的嗎？

en: Do you collect anything?
zh: 你有在收集什麼東西嗎？

en: If you could have any pet, what would you choose?
zh: 如果什麼寵物都能養，你會選什麼？

en: Do you play any sports?
zh: 你有在做什麼運動嗎？

en: What are your plans for tomorrow?
zh: 你明天有什麼計畫？

en: What kind of clothes do you like to wear?
zh: 你喜歡穿什麼風格的衣服？

en: What do you usually do before bed?
zh: 你睡前通常做什麼？

en: What's the most important thing in life for you?
zh: 對你來說，人生中最重要的是什麼？

en: How do you get to work or school every day?
zh: 你每天怎麼去上班或上學？

en: What's your favorite street food?
zh: 你最喜歡什麼路邊小吃？

en: Have you tried any Vietnamese food you really liked?
zh: 你有吃過哪道很喜歡的越南菜嗎？

en: What's the traffic like where you live?
zh: 你住的地方交通怎麼樣？

en: Do you have a favorite café?
zh: 你有喜歡的咖啡廳嗎？

en: What's one thing you're looking forward to this month?
zh: 這個月你最期待的一件事是什麼？

en: What did you have for lunch today?
zh: 你今天午餐吃了什麼？

en: Do you prefer to stay home or go out on Friday nights?
zh: 週五晚上你喜歡待在家還是出門？

en: What's the last book you read?
zh: 你最近讀的一本書是什麼？

en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
zh: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎？

en: What's your hometown like?
zh: 你的家鄉是什麼樣的地方？

en: What's a skill you're proud of?
zh: 你有什麼引以為傲的技能？

en: What app do you use the most on your phone?
zh: 你手機上最常用哪個 App？

en: Do you like shopping online or in stores?
zh: 你喜歡網購還是去實體店買？

en: What's the best trip you've ever taken?
zh: 你最棒的一次旅行是哪一次？

en: What do you do when you feel stressed?
zh: 你壓力大的時候會做什麼？

en: Are you a planner, or do you go with the flow?
zh: 你是喜歡計畫的人，還是隨遇而安？

en: What's something you've wanted to try but haven't yet?
zh: 有什麼你一直想試但還沒試過的事？

en: What's your favorite holiday?
zh: 你最喜歡哪個節日？

en: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
zh: 你通常怎麼過生日？

en: What's a song you've been listening to a lot?
zh: 你最近一直在聽哪首歌？

en: Do you like spicy food?
zh: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？

en: What's your favorite fruit?
zh: 你最喜歡什麼水果？

en: If you won the lottery, what's the first thing you'd buy?
zh: 如果中了樂透，你第一個會買什麼？

en: What was your favorite subject in school?
zh: 你以前在學校最喜歡哪一科？

en: Who's someone you really look up to?
zh: 有沒有你很崇拜的人？

en: What's a good piece of advice someone gave you?
zh: 有人給過你什麼很棒的建議？

en: Do you keep plants at home?
zh: 你家裡有種植物嗎？

en: What's your dream job?
zh: 你的夢想工作是什麼？

en: How do you like to spend a rainy afternoon?
zh: 下雨的午後你喜歡怎麼度過？

en: Do you like taking photos? What do you usually shoot?
zh: 你喜歡拍照嗎？通常拍什麼？

en: What's the funniest thing that happened to you this week?
zh: 這週發生在你身上最好笑的事是什麼？

en: Do you remember your first job?
zh: 你還記得你的第一份工作嗎？

en: What's something you always carry with you?
zh: 有什麼東西是你一定會隨身帶著的？

en: Do you prefer the city or the countryside?
zh: 你比較喜歡城市還是鄉下？

en: What languages would you like to speak someday?
zh: 你希望有一天會說哪些語言？

en: Why are you learning English?
zh: 你為什麼在學英文？

en: What's the hardest part of English for you?
zh: 對你來說英文最難的是哪個部分？

en: Do you watch videos or shows in English?
zh: 你會看英文的影片或節目嗎？

en: What's a word in English you really like?
zh: 有沒有哪個英文單字你特別喜歡？

en: How do you usually spend your evenings?
zh: 你晚上通常怎麼度過？

en: What did you do last weekend?
zh: 你上週末做了什麼？

en: What's the best gift you've ever received?
zh: 你收過最棒的禮物是什麼？

en: Do you like cooking at home or eating out?
zh: 你喜歡在家煮還是出去吃？

en: What's a habit you'd like to start?
zh: 你想養成什麼好習慣？

en: How do you stay healthy?
zh: 你怎麼保持健康？

en: Have you ever been to a concert?
zh: 你有去過演唱會嗎？

en: What's your favorite way to exercise?
zh: 你最喜歡用什麼方式運動？

en: What would your perfect day look like?
zh: 你心目中完美的一天是什麼樣子？

en: What's something that always makes you laugh?
zh: 有什麼東西總是能讓你笑出來？

en: Do you prefer hot weather or cold weather?
zh: 你喜歡熱天還是冷天？

en: What's one place in your city you'd show a visitor?
zh: 如果有朋友來玩，你會帶他去你城市的哪個地方？

en: What do you like most about where you live?
zh: 你最喜歡你住的地方哪一點？

en: What's a food you didn't like as a kid but like now?
zh: 有什麼食物是你小時候不喜歡、現在卻喜歡的？

en: Do you like getting up early on weekends?
zh: 你週末喜歡早起嗎？

en: What's something you're grateful for today?
zh: 今天有什麼讓你覺得感恩的事？

en: Who do you talk to the most every day?
zh: 你每天最常跟誰聊天？

en: What's the last thing you bought for yourself?
zh: 你最近買給自己的東西是什麼？

en: Do you like surprises?
zh: 你喜歡驚喜嗎？

en: What would you like to get better at this year?
zh: 今年你想在哪方面進步？

en: What's your go-to drink when you're tired?
zh: 你累的時候都喝什麼？

en: If you could live in another country for a year, where would it be?
zh: 如果可以在別的國家住一年，你會選哪裡？

en: What's a movie you could watch again and again?
zh: 有沒有哪部電影你看再多次都不會膩？
